## Also involved in

Work led by others where the lab contributes analysis or sequencing.

- **Multicellular development in a close animal relative**, with Omaya Dudin. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-08115-3).
- **Chemical ecology of temperate reefs**, with Doug Rasher and colleagues. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adt6788).
- **Species discovery in *Paulinella***, with Julia Van Etten. [Paper](https://par.nsf.gov/biblio/10703730).
